layout.hierarchy: Dark red (#990000) bold title dominates the top. Four pale-green (#E8F8F0) matrix panels are the main content; panels 2, 3 and 4 each carry a blue (#0000FF) underlined annotation header. Red (#FF0000) is used for emphasis (negative values, the W column label, Y, and the substituted 1s); blue for the '<0' entries, the class labels C1/C2, and Z. The two bottom boxed formulas (red #CC0000 border, pale-yellow #FFFFCC fill) serve as the conclusion.

visual_elements.description: Panel 1 (top-left): rows labeled x1,x2,x3,x4 each followed by '⇒' and a 3-column row vector: x1: 1 1 1; x2: 1 2 2; x3: 1 2 1; x4: 1 1 2. To the right a bracketed column labeled W (red) equals a column of inequalities: >0 (red), <0 (blue), >0 (red), <0 (blue).

Panel 2 (top-right): header 'Rearrange vecotrs (group vectors in same class)' in blue, underlined. Curly braces group rows: C1 contains x1 ⇒ 1 1 1 and x2 ⇒ 1 2 1; C2 contains x3 ⇒ 1 2 2 and x4 ⇒ 1 1 2. W column equals >0, >0 (red) then <0, <0 (blue).

Panel 3 (middle-right): header 'Multiply vectors belong to -ve class with -1' in blue underlined ('-ve' in red, '-1' in blue). Rows: x1 ⇒ 1 1 1; x2 ⇒ 1 2 1; x3 ⇒ -1 -2 -2 (red); x4 ⇒ -1 -1 -2 (red). W column equals >0 four times (red).

Panel 4 (middle-left): header 'Substitute > 0 with 1 (may use any small positive value)' with 'small' in red italic. Rows: x1 ⇒ 1 1 1; x2 ⇒ 1 2 1; x3 ⇒ -1 -2 -2 (red); x4 ⇒ -1 -1 -2 (red). A green horizontal line separates rows x1,x2 from x3,x4. W column equals four red 1s. Below: large 'Z' under the matrix, 'W = Y' under the right columns.

Four pink hatched block arrows (pink #F4C7C3 fill with dark-red #CC0000 hatching/outline): (1) pointing right from panel 1 to panel 2; (2) pointing down from panel 2 to panel 3; (3) pointing left from panel 3 to panel 4; (4) pointing right between the two bottom equation boxes.
Bottom-left box: red border, pale yellow fill, text 'The equation is in the form:' on first line and 'Z W = Y' large on second line (Z blue, W black, Y red).
Bottom-right box: red border, pale yellow fill, containing 'W = (Z^T Z)^-1 Z^T Y' with W black, Z blue, Y red.
Yellow circle with thin outline containing black number '33' (slide number).

Red (#FF0000) marks negative numbers, the W column label, Y, and the substituted 1s; blue (#0000FF) marks the '<0' entries, the class labels C1/C2, and Z. Bottom formulas are large bold inside red-bordered (#CC0000), pale-yellow (#FFFFCC) boxes; there W is black, Z blue, Y red.
